description: In build_email_from_create, mailbox_ids is built as HashMap<Id,bool> from the raw JSON without filtering out false entries. RFC 8621 §5.5.3 says values MUST be true; false means absent. Trigger: client sends {"mailboxIds": {"inbox": true, "trash": false}}. Bad behavior: the email is stored with mailbox_ids = {inbox: true, trash: false}. Then in handle_mailbox_set destroy, contains_key(&id) returns true for 'trash', so the cascade delete treats the email as being in trash and removes it from that mailbox (or destroys it). Keywords are correctly filtered (filter(|(_, v)| *v)); mailboxIds must be too.
title: Email/set create: mailboxIds false entries stored in email object
